watches.name: CHPTR_Δ [MDP] 40mm
watches.description: The CHPTR_Δ [MdP] (Chapter Delta), now in 40 mm. The blue configuration that became a favourite in 44 mm returns in a more compact format. Its sculptural dial brings together a conventional minute hand and a yellow hour marker that traces a triangular path. Designed and assembled in Neuchâtel.

watches.name: Chapter 7 Skeleton
watches.description: MECHANICS IN FULL VIEW The Chapter 7 Skeleton places Swiss mechanics at the heart of its design. Its openworked dial reveals the gears, bridges and architecture of the automatic movement beneath. As the wrist moves, light travels through the watch and brings every detail to life. The natural 316L stainless-steel case gives the Chapter 7 Skeleton a bright, architectural presence. Alternating polished and satin-brushed finishes create depth, while the asymmetric construction and crown positioned at 4 o’clock give it a character that is unmistakably BA111OD. At its heart beats the Swiss-made Soprod P024-SQ automatic skeleton movement, visible through both the dial and the transparent caseback. Two styles, one distinctive design. Choose the stainless-steel bracelet for a strong, sophisticated finish, or the frost blue rubber strap for a lighter and more contemporary look. Designed and assembled by hand in our workshop in the heart of Neuchâtel, the Chapter 7 Skeleton offers a striking way to experience Swiss mechanical watchmaking, from every angle.

watches.name: Chapter 7 Skeleton Anthracite
watches.description: The Chapter 7 Skeleton Anthracite begins with contrast. A darker silhouette, a sharper presence, and a play of light across brushed, polished and sandblasted surfaces. Its openworked dial reveals the mechanics of the Swiss automatic movement, while the 40 mm anthracite PVD case and integrated bracelet create a bold, fluid presence on the wrist. At BA111OD, transparency has always been part of the way we think, create and connect. With the Chapter 7 Skeleton, this idea takes on a new mechanical expression. The skeletonized dial reveals the movement with clarity and intention, not to demonstrate complexity, but to invite you to observe time in motion. Designed in-house and assembled in BA111OD’s workshop in Neuchâtel, it is a confident interpretation of Swiss Made skeleton watchmaking.

watches.name: Chapter 4 Skeleton Tourbillon T.V.D. (43mm)
watches.description: FIRST IN-HOUSE TOURBILLON A major milestone for BA111OD, the Chapter 4 Skeleton Tourbillon T.V.D. introduces the brand’s first in-house calibre, developed in La Chaux-de-Fonds with renowned watchmaker Olivier Mory. Its openworked architecture reveals the mechanics of the movement, from the tourbillon at 7 o’clock to the barrel that delivers an impressive 120-hour power reserve. Crafted in 904L stainless steel with a gunmetal anthracite DLC treatment, this 43 mm tourbillon combines technical depth with a sharper, more contemporary design language. It challenges traditional luxury codes with a clear idea: making a Swiss Made tourbillon with real mechanical substance more accessible, without compromising on precision, construction or character. In-house tourbillon calibre Developed in La Chaux-de-Fonds with Olivier Mory. 120h power reserve A long autonomy made possible by a visible barrel architecture. 904L steel case Finished with gunmetal anthracite DLC. Chronometer-certified Certified by the Geneva Observatory of Chronometry, Timelab for precision and reliability.

watches.name: CHPTR_Δ [AGIL] Club 11:10 Limited Edition
watches.description: Created as the first timepiece reserved for Club 11:10, this 40mm limited edition reflects BA111OD’s commitment to independent watchmaking rooted in Neuchâtel and shaped in close dialogue with its community. CHPTR_Δ (Delta) is the first manufacture complication developed by BA111OD in Neuchâtel, conceived to challenge traditional ways of reading time. Instead of a conventional rotating hand, the movement features a satellite hour wheel rolling around a fixed central hour wheel. This motion follows a deltoid cycloid with a 1:3 ratio, causing the tip of the hour hand to trace a perfect triangle. Time is no longer displayed in circles, but through a constantly evolving geometric form inspired by mechanical logic and mathematical precision. Developed in collaboration with independent watchmaker Olivier Mory, CHPTR_Δ introduces an asymmetrical reading of time and marks a world premiere. Presented in a 40 mm case and limited to 30 pieces, this edition is reserved exclusively for Club 11:10 members. A bold expression of Neuchâtel’s independent spirit, designed for collectors who choose to experience time differently.

watches.name: Chapter 8 - Sand
watches.description: Neo-Vintage Elegance, Reimagined Inspired by the understated elegance of mid-20th century watchmaking, Chapter 8 Sand brings timeless design into sharp modern focus. Clean lines, subtle textures and thoughtful proportions define this piece, refined but never nostalgic. In this sand execution, the collection reveals a softer and warmer expression, blending subtle character, balance and contemporary elegance. The 41mm 316L stainless steel case features a concave bezel, rounded lugs and a double anti-reflective sapphire crystal that enhances the clarity of its sandblasted dial. Luminous hands ensure perfect readability, day or night. The ergonomic crown at 4 o’clock and transparent caseback reflect the balance between design and function. At its heart, a Swiss Made Soprod P024 automatic movement powers the experience, visible, reliable and mechanical in the purest sense. Designed for everyday precision and lasting enjoyment, it reinforces the collection’s commitment to substance as much as style. Every Chapter 8 is imagined, designed and hand-assembled in our Neuchâtel atelier, a few steps from the original sketch. It is a watch born from intention: to offer access to fine Swiss watchmaking without compromising on soul, substance or precision.

watches.name: Chapter 4 Onyx Flying Tourbillon
watches.description: Pure. Minimal. Hypnotic. The Chapter 4 Onyx Flying Tourbillon is a bold exercise in restraint a watch that strips away the superfluous to reveal only what matters: the movement, the material, and the light. Housed in our new 41mm concave case crafted from polished 904L stainless steel , the piece features a deep black onyx dial , mirror-polished and left untouched. No markers. Just the natural beauty of the stone, absorbing light like a black hole. The flying tourbillon at 7 o’clock floats freely, without an upper bridge, a mesmerizing display of balance and precision. Beneath the sapphire box crystal, every detail is about clarity and contrast. The black-on-black logo is barely visible, by design a quiet nod rather than a shout. Powered by a hand-wound Swiss movement with 120 hours power reserve developed with Olivier Mory , this piece is for those who understand the value of silence in design and the poetry of mechanics in motion.

watches.name: Chapter 4 Infinity Flying Tourbillon
watches.description: The Art of Mastering Gravity A bold statement of mechanical poetry and Swiss precision. Designed for aesthetes and collectors, this chronometer-certified masterpiece elevates timekeeping into an art form. Encased in a subtly concave 41mm polished 904L stainless steel case with welded lugs, the timepiece showcases a cosmic blue sunray dial with a mesmerizing flying tourbillon at 7 o’clock, a hammered and polished moon phase at 1 o’clock, and a small seconds subdial at 10 o’clock. The dome-shaped box sapphire crystal reveals a meticulously hand-wound movement offering a 120-hour (5 day) power reserve. Developed in collaboration with acclaimed watchmaker Olivier Mory in La Chaux-de-Fonds, the flying tourbillon appears to defy gravity, its cage suspended in motion, compensating for gravitational effects to optimize precision. Certified by Timelab – Observatoire Chronométrique de Genève, the movement is a testament to exceptional accuracy and savoir-faire. Rooted in the centuries-old heritage of the Baillod family, this timepiece captures the spirit of Neuchâtel where tradition meets disruption.

watches.name: Chapter 4 Skeleton Tourbillon Ice White
watches.description: A Skeletonized Marvel - Precision in Motion Experience Swiss watchmaking in its purest form. The Chapter 4 Skeleton Tourbillon Ice White redefines elegance with its ultra-lightweight, open-worked design, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the mechanics of its hand-wound tourbillon movement. Encased in a sleek 40mm stainless steel case with a distinctive 4 o’clock crown , this unisex timepiece offers 100 hours of power reserve and a mesmerizing view of its skeletonized architecture. The tourbillon at 7 o’clock stands as a testament to precision, housed within a movement crafted in the heart of the Jura Arc. With its refined white aesthetic and interchangeable strap options, this watch is as versatile as it is sophisticated. List of compatible watchbands : Bracelets – BA111OD

watches.name: CHPTR_Δ.9 2-Tone
watches.description: CHPTR_Δ (Chapter Delta) is adorned with an elegant two-tone combination, pairing steel with a yellow gold PVD coating. This fusion of materials offers a look that is both classic and contemporary. CHPTR_Δ is the first BA111OD manufacture watch complication: a unique timepiece that represents time in a revolutionary way. Rather than simply rotating a hand around a central axis, the movement was designed to "roll" a satellite hour wheel around a fixed central hour wheel. When a wheel is rotated around another wheel, the trajectory described by any point on this satellite wheel is a cycloid. There are several types of cycloids: in this BA111OD chapter, the chosen cycloid is a deltoid (with a ratio of 1/3), and as a result, the trajectory described by the tip of the hour hand is... a triangle.
